{{Quote|As I was saying, bounty hunter, I have need of your services.''"<br />"''I'm listening.''"<br />"''I need a Jedi&hellip; holocron.|Darth Sidious and Cad Bane|<ref name="Holocron Heist" />}}
A '''mission''' was executed by acclaimed [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]], with the assistance of [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdite]] [[Cato Parasitti/Legends|Cato Parasitti]], on behalf of [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] to steal a [[Jedi holocron/Legends|Jedi holocron]] from the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]].<ref name="Holocron Heist Book" />

==History==
[[File:Bane_and_Todo.png|thumb|left|200px|Cad Bane and Todo 360 attempting to deactivate a laser gate]]
[[Cato Parasitti/Legends|Cato Parasitti]] assumed the identity of a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ord Enisence/Legends|Ord Enisence]] to sneak into the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]] and provide [[Cad Bane/Legends|Bane]] and [[Todo 360/Legends|Todo 360]] with inside information. Meanwhile, the two infiltrated the temple and, following the ventilation system, gained access to the [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] [[Holocron Vault/Legends|storage room]]. Parasitti knocked the [[Chief Librarian/Legends|librarian]] [[Jocasta Nu/Legends|Jocasta Nu]] unconscious and assume her identity, but it was by the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]. After a brief [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Tano]] managed to capture Parasitti. [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] followed Bane and the [[Techno-service droid/Legends|techno-service droid]], but were fooled by Bane, who ordered Todo 360 to split and to head for the [[Jedi Temple communication center/Legends|communications center]], leading the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] away from the true target. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] successfully managed to steal the [[Jedi holocron/Legends|Jedi holocron]] he was looking for and escaped the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], while detonating a bomb hidden inside Todo 360 served as a distraction maneuver.
